bug_info.bug_desc: In the standard-speed output-enable combinational logic, sd_en_o[0] is unconditionally assigned 1'b1 whenever any chip-select is asserted. This ignores whether the current segment is actually transmitting. For receive-only or dummy standard-speed segments, the SPI host therefore continues to drive serial data line 0, contrary to the specification that all serial-data output enables be off for receive-only/dummy segments and that standard-speed output enables be active only for transmit-only or bidirectional segments.
bug_info.fix_hint: Gate the standard-speed sd_en_o[0] assertion with the registered transmit-direction indication cmd_wr_en_q, matching the existing dual/quad speed behavior. This keeps SD0 driven only when the command segment is transmit-only or bidirectional.
